# research: git flow based on git config

Rethink how the per-project git flow is stored and invoked: keep its metadata (tracker type, project URL, issue key format) in `git config`, and use a `gitflow.Taskfile` or `git.Taskfile` as the entry point instead of a set of repo-local aliases.

Today [git_flow](../../bin/git_flow) `github|jira <url>` writes five aliases (`start`, `stop`, `progress`, `issue`, `done`) into the repository's config, each embedding the URL and the branch-name parsing as shell text; changing the flow means re-running `git flow` in every repository. Config keys plus a script that reads them would separate data from behaviour and make the behaviour updatable through the dotfiles.
